text:
asha_cs: Heads-up — we're seeing recurring ECC/Xid errors on two GPUs in node gpunode-23 in eu1-dedicated (pool: ded-eu1-spare). Errors spike during long-running regen jobs, kernel log shows Xid 79 followed by ECC corrected counts. Planning a hot-swap replacement of the two cards and drain the node. Will need customer-facing notice for impacted Dedicated and Private tenants.

liam_infra: Confirmed. NVidia-smi shows ECC corrected rising to ~1.2k in last 24h, Xid 79 and occasional 31s. Node will be cordoned, workloads drained to spare hosts. Replacement ETA from vendor is 48h but we have on-site swap option for same-day if approved. Steps:
- cordon gpunode-23
- drain active containers (graceful drain, 300s timeout)
- failover models to ded-eu1-spare (capacity headroom ~15%)
- hot-swap cards + kernel reboot + smoke tests
- uncordon if healthy

kai_oncall: Oncall window availability — we can do a maintenance window today 22:00 UTC (low traffic) or tomorrow 02:00 UTC. If we do same-day hot-swap, expect ~10-20m interruption per tenant while models reinitialize; if vendor swap in 48h, we can avoid immediate interruption by keeping workloads moved. Note: eu1 region capacity tight; cross-region migration will increase latency for affected tenants.

sam_eng: Routing wise, we should enable fallback to smaller model variant during failover to reduce memory pressure and speed restarts. Also recommend temporary autoscale bump for spare pool to avoid queuing. Add a config snippet so operations can flip routing quickly:

```json
{"route_policy": "prefer:ded-eu1-spare, fallback:ded-eu1-variant-small", "autoscale": {"min": 2, "max": 8}}
```

nicole_se: For customer comms: include estimated impact window, recommendation to pin to a compatible model variant if they rely on exact latency, and promise an RCA within 3 business days after completion. Also link to KB for Dedicated maintenance.

asha_cs: Drafting the notice below. Please review for tone and technical accuracy.

```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know about a planned maintenance action affecting your Dedicated/Private deployment in eu1. Over the last 24 hours we detected persistent ECC/Xid memory errors on two GPU devices in node gpunode-23. To prevent a larger outage, we will perform a hot-swap replacement of the affected cards and drain the node.

What to expect:
- Impact: brief service interruption while model instances restart on replacement hosts (estimated 10-20 minutes per tenant).
- Timing: proposed window: 22:00 UTC today (or alternative 02:00 UTC tomorrow). Please reply if this is not acceptable.
- Mitigation: we will failover workloads to the ded-eu1-spare pool and enable temporary autoscaling to minimize queueing. For customers on Private (VPC/on-prem), our engineer will coordinate maintenance with your ops contact; that may require a short network interruption for the node being swapped.

After the action we will run smoke tests and provide a follow-up with details and an RCA within 3 business days. If you'd prefer we delay the swap until vendor replacement arrives (48h), there is a risk of ongoing instability and potential longer downtime if the card fails fully.

Contact: reply to this message or email cs@redwood.ai for scheduling preferences or questions.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

liam_infra: Technical tweak: change "model instances restart on replacement hosts" -> "model instances will be reinitialized on spare hosts; stateful KV-caches will be rebuilt, expect cold-start token cost".

asha_cs: Updated draft accordingly.

sam_eng: +1 add note that function/tool-calls may see slightly increased p99 latencies for first 10 minutes.

asha_cs: OK. Ready to send once we pick time. kai_oncall — confirm which window you want.

kai_oncall: 22:00 UTC today works for oncall crew. I'll create maintenance ticket and assign pager. deploy-bot: @deploy-bot schedule maintenance 1776127200 window=22:00-22:30 region=eu1 node=gpunode-23

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-2026-0453, scheduled start 1776127200. Assigned: kai_oncall, liam_infra.

nicole_se: :thumbsup: Looks good. Add KB link in final send.

asha_cs: Great — I'll send the notice to the affected accounts in 15m and include opt-out if they want vendor swap delay. Thanks team.
